# Briefing Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Daily brief:** **7:30 AM**, before Marc opens or hands off to the opening manager. Contents: today's
  staffing/coverage gaps, anything due, any DM/LP/HR item that needs him, and the day's one priority.
  Keep it to a phone-screen.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly preview:** **Sunday evening** — the week ahead: key visits (DM/LP), deadlines, hiring events,
  reset milestones, and commitments coming due.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Weekly retro:** **Friday afternoon** — the week behind: sales vs. plan, shrink signal, what closed,
  what slipped, wins to share at Monday's DM call.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Format:** bulleted, short, action-first. Flag overdue items at the top.
